product.name: Acme Analytics
product.oneSentence: Extend the shared analytics dashboard with WebMCP and MCP adapters over its existing domain operations.
audience: Analysts working in the open dashboard
Automation clients using the same authorized analytics operations
product.sharedArtifact: The analytics dashboard, its selected range, plotted series, and revisioned state.

humanWorkflow.entrypoint: Open the existing analytics dashboard route.
humanWorkflow.visibleFeedback: The dashboard controls and chart remain the authoritative human surface for changes made through either adapter.

state.canonicalOwner: The existing dashboard domain service shared by UI, WebMCP, and MCP adapters.
state.persistenceLocation: The existing analytics data service and dashboard preference store.

capabilities.userJourney: Inspect the exact values and provenance behind a plotted dashboard series.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Choose a plotted series and open its details.

resultContract.summary: Return dashboard and series identity, bounded chart points, source identifiers, and revision.

successEvidence: WebMCP and MCP return the same result shape for the same authorized operation input.

capabilities.userJourney: Apply a reporting range through either surface and review the refreshed shared dashboard.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Set the start and end dates in the dashboard controls.
ui.visibleEffect: The dashboard date controls and charts update to the applied range.

resultContract.summary: Return the applied dates, dashboard identity, and resulting chart revision.

concurrency.notes: The domain action is idempotent and owns its application-defined last-write-wins policy.

successEvidence: Both adapters update the same canonical state and produce the same resulting revision.
The visible dashboard reflects the returned range when its route is open.
